description: Price WorldTrips Atlas Travel visitor insurance for a family (non-U.S. citizens traveling to the U.S.) — a verified base premium only when the pinned carrier rate card is intact and the website's family total for identical inputs agrees with it to the cent. Returns per-traveler age-band daily rates, the family total, and a prefilled compare link; otherwise an explicit needs_clarification, unsupported_composition, stale, price_discrepancy or unavailable status plus the compare link. Base premium in USD only — the carrier may add taxes and fees, confirms final price and eligibility, and the tool never buys a plan or takes payment details.

deductible.description: Deductible in USD — only the pinned card columns are supported.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination. Must be US for the verified Atlas America slice; omit and the tool asks instead of guessing.

end_date.description: Last day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; at least one day after start_date.

max_coverage.description: Coverage maximum in USD — only the pinned card columns are supported.

product.description: The only verified product: WorldTrips Atlas Travel (Atlas America).

residence_citizenship.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country all travelers share as residence AND citizenship. Must not be the US or a US territory; omit and the tool asks instead of guessing.

start_date.description: First day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; today (UTC) or later.

travelers.description: The family to price: exactly one self, at most one spouse, and up to five children. Ages are whole years on the coverage start date — no dates of birth.

age.description: The traveler's age in whole years on the coverage start date.

name: search_family_insurance_plans
title: Price a verified Atlas Travel family
